notes.title: Fixed a bug that prevented Steam from recognizing executable files.
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where the file name of the executable file had changed and Steam could no longer recognize the executable file.

notes.title: Fixed a bug in the language switching function
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that prevented switching languages due to a communication error with the translation server when trying to select a language other than Japanese.

notes.title: Fixed a bug.
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where characters and illustrations were not displayed correctly when playing in languages other than Japanese.
